newsitem.title: USA: Sanwa names Michael Strauss sr VP, chief economist.
newsitem.headline: Sanwa names Michael Strauss sr VP, chief economist.

text.p: Former Yamaichi International (America) Securities chief economist Michael Strauss was named senior vice president and chief economist at Sanwa Securities Co, effective today, the company said on Monday.
"It is an exciting opportunity," Strauss said, noting that he knows a number of his new collegues.
Strauss replaces Michelle Laughlin, who left a few months ago to become a Treasury market strategist at Prudential Securities. He said he will primarily focus on the fixed-income sector.
Since then, Sanwa "conducted a pretty thourough search" lasting about three months, said James Powers, Sanwa's co-president. "He was the most qualified," Powers said. "We are happy to have him."
Strauss left Yamaichi along with Patrick Lynch, manager of fixed income, in late November when the company was undergoing changes in its fixed income area.

Prior to his 4-1/2-year stint as chief economist at Yamaichi, Strauss was chief economist at UBS Securities for five years, vice president and fixed income economist at E.F Hutton for one year and vice president and co-manager of MCM MoneyWatch for four years.
He has an undergraduate degree in economics from Cornell University and graduate degrees in economics and finance from New York University.
